title: SAP Project Manager
description:
Job Description:
client is looking for a highly organized and experienced SAP Project Manager, PMO to drive the successful execution of SAP-related projects within our established Project Management Office (PMO).
  • In this role, you will be responsible for managing project lifecycles, ensuring adherence to PMO standards, and delivering projects on time, within budget, and to the required quality.
  • You'll work closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to achieve project objectives and contribute to the overall success of our SAP initiatives.

Responsibilities:
Project Planning and Execution:
  • Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and communication strategies.
  • Manage project execution, ensuring tasks are completed according to the plan and PMO standards.
  • Track project progress, monitor milestones, and provide regular status updates to stakeholders.
  • Identify and manage project risks and issues, developing mitigation plans as needed.

PMO Adherence and Governance:
  • Ensure all assigned projects adhere to the established PMO methodologies, standards, and processes.
  • Utilize PMO tools and templates for project planning, tracking, and reporting.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO processes and best practices.
  • Participate in PMO meetings and provide project-related updates.

Stakeholder Management and Communication:
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with project stakeholders, including business users, IT teams, and external consultants.
  • Facilitate effective communication within the project team and with stakeholders.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and address any concerns or conflicts.
  • Organize and lead project meetings, ensuring clear agendas and documented outcomes.

Resource and Budget Management:
  • Manage project resources effectively, ensuring they are allocated appropriately and utilized efficiently.
  • Track project budgets and expenditures, ensuring projects stay within approved limits.
  • Identify and escalate any potential budget overruns.

Quality Assurance:
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and business requirements.
  • Participate in quality reviews and testing processes as needed.

Documentation and Reporting:
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation, including project plans, status reports, risk logs, and issue logs.
  • Prepare and present project reports to stakeholders and management.

Collaboration:
  • Work closely with other Project Managers and PMO team members to share best practices and lessons learned.
  • Collaborate with SAP functional and technical teams to ensure successful project delivery.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field
  • 8–10 years of experience managing SAP implementation, upgrade, or enhancement projects
  • Solid understanding of SAP modules and implementation methodologies (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, ECC, Activate)
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid)
  • Proven ability to develop and manage project plans, budgets, and timelines
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), interpersonal, and presentation skills
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and time management skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Proficiency in project management software and tools (e.g., SAP Solution Manager, Microsoft Project, Jira)

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience in utility, energy, or regulated industry environments is a plus
  • PMP or other relevant project management certification
  • Experience working within a formal PMO structure
  • Knowledge of change management principles

title: GOAPRDJP00000706 Database Administrator - Senior
description:
Duties:
This role is responsible for building, maintaining, and performance tuning production databases to deliver databases with appropriate levels of data availability and performance. This role is also responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing database procedures and standards.

• Provide technical expertise in database management systems to support systems development and operational activities.

• Create and maintain the logical and physical structures of databases and related structures required by database applications.

• Monitor database applications, databases and DBMS statistics and recommend the appropriate changes to improve performance.

• Maintain database authorization requirements.

• Maintain and enforce database security standards and procedures.

• Evaluate application and user requirements and recommend appropriate database modifications.

• Provide technical expertise to development teams, Application Maintenance Services and business teams if engaged.

• Perform troubleshooting activities for database problems, database software problems and database application problems.

• Perform DBMS software installations, plan and test upgrades.

• Plan, test and implement software patches and application updates or upgrades.

• Disaster recovery preparation and testing.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation.

• Develop and automate system related procedures.

• Perform problem diagnosis, troubleshooting and resolution.

• Monitor on-going operations and perform on-going system administration tasks: release new versions; database tuning; capacity planning; historical archiving; database consistency and integrity checking; log file analysis; job scheduling; scripting; indexes; reorganizations; change control; and server requirements analysis.
